This is an ordinary follow-up commit (no amend, no reset). It touches 6 files under docs/verification/platform/** only. Contract 0.1.0, dependencies and root files are unchanged. No Swift was written and no capability research was redone.

Reads folded into this report:
- 693069ac9e83ad955f808ca934b7fbec643f40f3: ADR 0002 §4 and §7, and the platform follow-up in docs/verification/lead/p0-review-integration.md.
- 6efa59e338d80e5373aad71c0db4e0774ed11bfb: english-working-policy.md, the translation manifest, and the relevant parts of the four *.en.md files (the companion §7 P1 fallback and the intent-and-decisions confirmed decisions).
  - All 8 source and translation SHA-256 values match the manifest.
  - The four Chinese sources are byte-identical to 9ce270c, so no P0-11 content changes follow from the policy.
  - The English Q-INK-DISPLAY wording ("retain the original anchor and explain the current state") agrees with revision 3.
  - The P1 "may be offered" fallback is consistent with plan §8. I found no translation gap to report.

The two corrections you asked for:
1. Share state (plan §7 and §9 step 5, checklist DT-G7-Q02 and DT-G7-E01 step 5). Every outcome is an append-only fact:
   - Opening the share sheet adds a separate share_panel_opened fact, and the ExportJob stays prepared. This is never a successful share.
   - completed == true with the actual target activityType → shared, with import pending.
   - A cancel keeps the prior state (prepared if never shared) and records the cancellation.
   - An activity error records failed. A termination with no callback records unknown.
   - imported requires an actual target observation.
   - No later fact rewrites an earlier shared or imported fact. Q02 now runs a cancel, a failure and an unknown attempt after a shared fact and after an imported observation, and checks that earlier history is unchanged.
   - user_reported is still never machine verification. A46 step 6 still passes only on an actual observation in Notability.
   - Following ADR §7, possible external exposure is recorded when help-bearing content is shared or dispatched with an unknown outcome.
2. Per-source stop (plan §4 and §5, checklist DT-G7-R01 and DT-G7-R02, and P0-03 DT-G3-10):
   - The no-capture and no-send rules apply only to the stopped source (that device and path).
   - An already-enabled source continues, including another path on the same device. A source that was off stays off. A stop never starts anything elsewhere.
   - The stopped source's old frames are labelled stale.
   - R02 adds a run with a second source active and a third source off.
   - P0-03 DT-G3-10 is rewritten as diagnosed in support 7cb9057 (R36/A16).

ADR 0002 alignment (I treated ADR 0002 as proposed, not approved):
- §4: a stop ends the live stream. Queued pre-stop items stay local with the final queue boundary recorded, and they sync as history only when that sync is independently authorized. R01 runs both an authorized and an unauthorized variant.
- §7 screen-fixed ink: while the same known problem and source continue, including ordinary playback, the ink keeps its screen position and visible written-at context. It never becomes ink on later frames. A different problem or material version (including a new video, or a single-page-app change to a different problem) or unresolved placement → hide or mark with a notice, and never re-bind. The INT-02W and INT-02A matrix rows were updated to match.
- Content-anchored ink needs a valid content transform; there is no video-object tracking.

Differences with Web P0-12 that stay open for you in plan §16:
- (a) per-source scope of "no new frames leave the device";
- (b) syncing queued pre-stop items after a stop (Web keeps them local);
- (c) screen-fixed ink during continuous playback (Web hides it);
- (d) screen-fixed ink after a seek within the same source: ADR §7 does not settle this, so K02 records the observed behaviour;
- (e) export mapping (Web still maps "opened → shared");
- (f) per-frame anchors and the ink-handoff route, which wait for the formal contract.
I made no 0.1.0 field additions.

Checks run:
- .venv/bin/python apps/ios/tools/check_capability_matrix.py --matrix p0-11 --self-test: 48 rows valid, markdown in sync, 23 mutations rejected, and a well-formed device failure accepted.
- The default p0-03 profile: 62 rows valid.
- .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q: 42 passed.
- git diff --check: clean.
- One independent read-only review of the diff before commit found 7 issues (none high), all fixed. Examples: a remaining device-wide wording in §16, R01 still pointing to an open P0-08 question, and a proposed ADR being labelled "resolved".

Still unverified: nothing is implemented, compiled, connected to a provider or run on a device.
